findings.issue: wait_ci resolves the pushed branch with `git rev-parse ci/v<version>`, but step_push_ci_branch pushes `HEAD:refs/heads/ci/v<version>` and creates no local branch; only refs/remotes/origin/ci/v<version> exists.
